info.title: schoolsoft-agent connector REST API
info.description:
Read-only JSON for custom UIs, served by a parent-hosted schoolsoft-agent connector (an independent project; SchoolSoft AB is not involved). Generated from the connector's own route table and Zod schemas (`make docs`); the human-readable reference is `docs/reference/rest-api.md`.

**Tokens.** Every request carries `Authorization: Bearer <access token>` from the connector's OAuth 2.1 authorization-code flow with PKCE (register with `POST /register` as a public client, then `/authorize` and `/token`). The connector is one OAuth protected resource named `https://<connector>/mcp`, also for REST: ask for tokens with `resource=https://<connector>/mcp`; its metadata is at `/.well-known/oauth-protected-resource/mcp`, and the `401` challenge on `/api/v1` points there. Access tokens live 5 minutes. Refresh tokens rotate, and presenting one twice revokes the whole connection: refresh one at a time.

**Problems.** Failures are `application/problem+json` with `type` `urn:schoolsoft-agent:problem:<name>`; branch on `type`, `status`, `kind` and `retryable`, never on text. `401` is always the app's token; `409` is always the connector's SchoolSoft sign-in (send the parent to `ownerDashboard`).

**Limits.** Same-origin only (no CORS headers; another site's `Origin` is refused). 60 requests per minute per caller. New response fields may appear within v1: ignore fields you do not know.

get.description: What the calling connection may do and whether the connector can serve it now. Never starts a SchoolSoft login or BankID. Show data when `schoolsoft.signedIn` is true; otherwise link the parent to `ownerDashboard`, unless `schoolsoft.portal.state` is not `ok`.

401.description: The access token is missing, invalid or expired (the MCP SDK's RFC 6750 answer with `WWW-Authenticate`), or the connection was revoked while the request waited (`oauth-token`). Refresh the token once; connect again if that fails.

403.description: `foreign-origin`: The request carried another site's `Origin`; the API is same-origin only.

429.description: `rate-limited`: Per-caller limit reached; `Retry-After` says when to try again.

500.description: `internal`: A bug in the connector. No detail is returned.

get.description: Operation `list_children`, scope `list_children`. The answer is the operation's validated domain object; one that does not fit is a `502` `response-drift`.

400.description: `invalid-input`: Path or query parameters do not fit the operation's input.

401.description: The access token is missing, invalid or expired (the MCP SDK's RFC 6750 answer with `WWW-Authenticate`), or the connection was revoked while the request waited (`oauth-token`). Refresh the token once; connect again if that fails.

403.description: `foreign-origin`: The request carried another site's `Origin`; the API is same-origin only. `scope-not-granted`: The token's scopes do not include this operation. Nothing was read. `child-not-permitted`: The child is outside this connection's grant or no longer on the account. Nothing was read.

409.description: `schoolsoft-session`: The connector is not signed in to SchoolSoft (never signed in, signed out, or the saved session expired). The token is fine; only the parent can fix this, on the owner dashboard (`ownerDashboard`). `web-session`: The data needs SchoolSoft's separate web login, which the connector does not offer.

429.description: `rate-limited`: Per-caller limit reached; `Retry-After` says when to try again.

500.description: `internal`: A bug in the connector. No detail is returned.

501.description: `not-implemented`: The school portal or the connector does not offer this capability.

502.description: `response-drift`: The portal answered in a shape that does not map to the domain model; nothing was returned. Retrying does not help. `upstream`: The portal answered with an error. Usually temporary.

503.description: `connector-busy`: Too many requests queued, the connector is shutting down, or the child in focus changed while the request waited. `Retry-After` is set. `portal-pushback`: The school portal asked for fewer requests or kept failing, so the connector sends it nothing for a while. `Retry-After` and `retryAt` say when to try again; signing in again does not help. `not-available`: The connector cannot serve this now (for example its stored state is from a newer version).

504.description: `network`: The connector could not reach the portal (DNS, TCP, TLS or timeout).

get.description: The week's lessons and lunch and the next school event, each section `ok`, `not-granted` or `error` with its own problem, read in one turn of the connector's queue. No scope of its own: any one of the three section scopes admits the request, and a section whose scope is missing is `not-granted`. Weeks are ISO weeks named by their Europe/Stockholm dates.

parameters.description: Any day of the week to show, YYYY-MM-DD, within about half a year of today. Defaults to today in Europe/Stockholm.

oauth.description: Authorization code with PKCE (S256), public clients. Resource indicator: `https://<connector>/mcp`. One scope per operation; the parent approves scopes and children on the connector's consent page.

signedIn.description: The connector's SchoolSoft session is present and valid

loginInProgress.description: The parent started a sign-in that has not finished

webSession.description: A gated web-login session is stored (the connector does not offer one; always false today)

state.description: `ok`: requests to the school portal flow; `backing_off`: a short pause after the portal pushed back; `paused`: the portal pushed back repeatedly and the connector sends it nothing until `retryAt`; `probing`: the next request tests whether it answers again

retryAt.description: When requests flow again; null while they flow or a probe decides
